description: A query recognizes a prefix whose outer continuation fails. The completed stage keeps the rival that can reach its end (engine §4.1 and §10).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution leftmost-longest #·preferred, greedy
%rule text ($x:r B) %conditions ($x.onward.parse(preferred …) ∧ $x ≅ #short)

%rule r preferred | short
%rule preferred (A B)
               
%rule short A
